notes_for_editor: Thin record: firelookout.com has one short entry, Forest Lookouts has one line, and the FFLA list has one line. No USFWS, Malheur refuge or current-condition page was found in two searches, so access and staffing are omitted rather than guessed. The 1930s date is decade-only in both sources, so no built event with a year was entered. Elevation 4,140 ft matches the record's 1261.9 m. Do not merge with the Douglas County Rattlesnake Mountain site (firetower.org lists a 1933 photo under that name; it belongs to the gone Douglas County site).
